config.accept_rule: 5th percentile (sorted index floor(0.05*(n-1))) of out-of-sample split Sharpes of the in-sample-best configuration > 0; embargo bars dropped at both ends of every block
config.garch: alpha 0.10, beta 0.85, Student-t df 5 unit variance, unconditional bar vol 0.02/sqrt(12), zero drift
config.leak_rule: lookahead grid (horizon fast/10 bars, threshold slow/100 bps) on bars drawn with probability equal to the fraction, causal sma elsewhere

data_sources.url: synthetic seeded GARCH(1,1) Student-t series generated in-process
